opening.argument: The presentation ties paid education packages directly to cryptocurrency production and money returning to the purchaser. It states that packages include tokens needed to “actually produce cryptocurrency coins, which puts money right back into your pocket,” then identifies a five-hundred-euro package with five thousand tokens and a token-to-coin production relationship. It further presents the model as operating “without having to recruit anyone.” Alongside conditional predictions of doubled or quadrupled value, package-linked dollar outcomes, declining coin allocations, and a deadline for a free-gold benefit, these claims press for immediate purchase without verifying projected returns, gold backing, or the benefit terms.
